## Summary

Fixes #971.

Omit an empty optional `preferred_account` at the profile mutation boundary instead of sending `""`, which Landscape server rejects with `MissingParameterError`. Keep the controlled form's blank default-organization option, and continue sending existing or newly selected valid preferences unchanged. This allows name/timezone edits without forcing a default organization, including when the selector is hidden for single-account or subdomain users.

Add ten request-payload regression cases covering self-hosted and SaaS modes, unset preferences with visible/hidden selectors, existing defaults, and newly selected defaults. Six unset-preference cases failed against the original implementation and pass with this fix. Include a patch changeset.

**Where to Find the UI Changes (if applicable)**

Open **Account settings → General**, `/account/general` (for example `http://localhost:5173/account/general`). Use a password-capable disposable user with `GET /api/v2/person` returning `preferred_account: null`. The change is behavioral; there are no layout changes.

**Testing Instructions** _(optional)_

1. With an unset preference, change only **Name** and save. Expect HTTP 200, no `preferred_account` key in the POST JSON, the new Name persisted, and the preference still null. Verify a single-organization user whose default selector is hidden as well as a multi-organization user who leaves the blank default untouched.
2. Switch the active sidebar **Organization** and save another name change without setting a default. It should still succeed without selecting a preference.
3. Choose a valid **Default organization** and save. Expect the chosen preference to persist; later name-only saves must preserve it.
4. Confirm existing valid defaults still work, including when the active organization differs from the stored default.

**Validation performed**

- `VITE_API_URL=/api/v2/ VITE_API_URL_OLD=/api/ VITE_API_URL_DEB_ARCHIVE=/debarchive/v1/ VITE_ROOT_PATH=/ pnpm vitest run src/features/general-settings --reporter=dot` — **passed**, 4 files / 31 tests, including all ten new payload cases.
- `VITE_API_URL=/api/v2/ VITE_API_URL_OLD=/api/ VITE_ROOT_PATH=/portal/ pnpm build` — **passed**: repository lint, CSS type generation, TypeScript, and production Vite build. Existing warnings remain; no lint errors.
- `pnpm exec eslint src/features/general-settings/components/EditUserForm/EditUserForm.test.tsx src/features/general-settings/hooks/useUserGeneralSettings.ts` — **passed**, zero errors; one pre-existing rules-of-hooks warning on the unchanged `getUserDetails` query helper.
- `pnpm exec prettier --check src/features/general-settings/components/EditUserForm/EditUserForm.test.tsx src/features/general-settings/hooks/useUserGeneralSettings.ts .changeset/thirty-swans-create.md` — **passed**.
- `git diff --check` — **passed**.

**Real-backend browser verification:** a local Playwright/Chromium artifact driver executed **19 form submissions, all HTTP 200**, against isolated self-hosted and actual local SaaS-development backends with MSW disabled, fresh browser contexts, and no response mocks or frontend mode overrides. Nine requests correctly omitted the unset preference; ten preserved or set valid preferences. Every case checked the real request body and persisted Name, email, timezone, and preference. Coverage included single/multiple accounts, active-account switching, stale former-membership preferences, and a SaaS subdomain-marked account.

Server revision: `fced839432c819b0b71945595804b4c9bd5562d6`, fetched from latest server `main` on 2026-10-28. The retained image was source-hash-verified against that checkout, not clean-rebuilt. Local SaaS-development used development password authentication; production SaaS, external identity providers, and actual tenant DNS routing were not tested. Self-hosted multiple memberships were model-seeded test scenarios. Raw request/response/state evidence and screenshots are retained in the investigation session; disposable fixture credentials and local driver scripts are not committed.

>

> - `dev` → `YY.MM.0.<run>-dev`
> - `release/YY.MM` → `YY.MM.1.<run>` (cycle pinned by branch name)
